parameters.value: Digital Ultrasonic Non-Contact Flowmeter with a Totalizer is a device that measures the flow rate of a liquid without any physical contact, it uses ultrasonic technology to detect the fluid's velocity to calculate volumetric flow rate of fluid.
Ultrasonic Non-Contact Flowmeter with Totalizer consists of three main components, 2 nos. Ultrasonic Transducers, Transmitter/Indicator Unit, and Totalizer.

The transducers, mounted externally on the pipe, emit and receive ultrasonic signals to measure the fluid's velocity, the transmitter processes these signals, calculating the flow rate, and the Totalizer accumulates these measurements over time.
Suitable LED / LCD with suitable communiaction buttons
Suitable of Pipe Diameter of 300mm or more
